name: Chat Testimonials
summary: A testimonial carousel of chat-bubble quotes with a speech tail, author line and company badge, driven by prev/next chevrons, arrow keys and swipe on a 600ms translating track.
useWhen: A landing page wants customer quotes shown as chat messages
Quotes of varying length should scroll sideways with chevron controls
avoidWhen: Quotes should be arranged in a grid or globe; use marketing/testimonial-globe
